editorial:
Imagine being stuck in your own backyard your entire life because your parents told you the outside world is way too dangerous. That is exactly what happens to the three siblings in this wild story. They live on a big estate and have no idea how the real world works because their dad has literally rewritten the dictionary for them. You will see things like a yellow flower being called a zombie and a chair being called the sea. It feels like you are watching a weird social experiment where the kids are treated more like pets than people, and it creates a very strange, tense mood that keeps you wondering when someone will finally snap.

The acting is great because everyone speaks in a flat, robotic way that makes the whole thing feel even creepier. While the slow pace might bore some people, the shock value and the weird rules make it a ride you won't forget. If you like stories that make you feel uncomfortable and curious, you need to see this. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection if you want the best quality, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends who like odd films.
endingExplained: The youngest daughter eventually escapes the house and discovers the truth about the world. She tries to help her siblings break free from their parents' lies. In the end, the children turn against their father and kick him out of the house. However, the daughter realizes that she cannot simply forget the trauma. She ends up hurting herself to cope with the pain of her upbringing, showing that the parents' control left deep scars.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves strange stories and psychological puzzles.
